scene_summary: A surreal, finely rendered coastal scene places a floating black armored vessel bound in ivory ribs and articulated bones near the center-right. A tall broken turquoise gateway rises at left; a separate suspended arrangement of fruit, flowers, drapery, classical figures and a peacock occupies the upper right. A pale moon and open blue sky separate the three principal forms. The planned machine-and-bone anchor is clearly visible, although the overall plate is illustrative rather than minimal and expressionist.
usable_surfaces: Ribbed black armored nose clasped by ivory ribs
Circular metal housings interlocked with bent skeletal limbs
Serrated upper casing and bone-bound lower edge

detected_objects.label: Bulbous black armored vessel clasped by ivory ribs and bent limbs
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The dominant floating object has a rounded riveted black nose, curved segmented casing, circular side housings and sharp dorsal fins. Pale ribs arc over its front and body; skull-like joints and bent long bones clasp the right side and lower edge. The polygon follows this connected assemblage, excluding the detached ornamental island, gateway and surrounding sky. Fine projecting bones and the serrated silhouette are simplified within the vertex limit.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Open sky isolates the mapped anchor, making a single source window legible. However, the large gateway, intricate ornamental island and detailed coastal foreground create competing visual detail. This is a controlled but elaborate surreal illustration, not a minimal expressionist plate. The detached elements are not counted as additional source windows.
